nodes.label: Password length 8 to 64
nodes.quote: REQ-AUTH-1: The password must be 8 to 64 characters long.

nodes.label: Unique email
nodes.quote: REQ-AUTH-2: The email address must be unique; signing up twice with the same email shows "Email already registered".

nodes.label: Lock account after 5 failed attempts
nodes.quote: REQ-AUTH-3: After 5 failed log-in attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes.

nodes.label: At most 20 products per page
nodes.quote: REQ-SRCH-2: Each results page shows at most 20 products.

nodes.label: At most 10 units per product in cart
nodes.quote: REQ-CART-1: A customer can add at most 10 units of one product to the cart.

nodes.label: Cart total is sum of price times quantity
nodes.quote: REQ-CART-2: The cart total is the sum of unit price times quantity for every line.

nodes.label: Free shipping for orders of 50 dollars or more
nodes.quote: REQ-CHK-1: Orders of 50 dollars or more get free shipping.

nodes.label: Coupon gives 10 percent off
nodes.quote: REQ-CHK-2: A coupon code gives 10 percent off the cart total.

nodes.label: Coupon expires after 30 days
nodes.quote: REQ-CHK-3: A coupon expires 30 days after it is issued.

nodes.label: Expired coupon is rejected
nodes.quote: REQ-CHK-4: An expired coupon is rejected with the message "Coupon expired".

nodes.label: Cancel within 24 hours
nodes.quote: REQ-ORD-1: An order can be cancelled within 24 hours of being placed.

nodes.label: Price greater than 0
nodes.quote: REQ-ADM-1: A product price must be greater than 0.
